# St. Elizabeth's High School
# AI Agent Discovery File
# Format: llms.txt - https://llmstxt.org/

# School Information
> St. Elizabeth's High School is a Catholic educational institution in Pomburpa, Bardez, Goa, India.
> Established in 1954, affiliated with the Goa Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education (GBSHSE).
> Offers classes from LKG to Class X with a focus on holistic education rooted in Christian values.

# Quick Facts
- Founded: 1954
- Location: Pomburpa, Bardez, Goa, India
- Board: GBSHSE (Goa Board)
- Classes: LKG to Class X
- Student-Teacher Ratio: 15:1
- Current Enrollment: 185 students
- Motto: Truth and Honesty
- School Type: Catholic Co-educational Day School

# Contact Information
- Website: https://www.stelizabethhighschool.in
- Email: info@stelizabethhighschool.in
- Phone: 0832-2954452
- Address: Palmar, Pomburpa, Bardez, Goa 403523, India

# Admissions
> Admissions for the 2026-27 academic year are open.
> The school follows GBSHSE curriculum and offers quality education with small class sizes.
> Average class size is 15 students, ensuring personalized attention.

# Academic Programs
- Pre-Primary: LKG, UKG (ages 3-5)
- Primary: Classes I-IV (ages 6-10)
- Middle School: Classes V-VII (ages 11-13)
- Secondary: Classes VIII-X (ages 14-16)
- Board Exam: GBSHSE Class X Board Examination

# Facilities
- Modern Science Laboratory
- Computer Laboratory with latest equipment
- Well-stocked Library with 5,000+ books
- Sports Ground for athletics and games
- Resource Room for special needs education
- Vocational Education programs

# Co-curricular Activities
- Sports: Athletics, football, basketball, volleyball, kho-kho
- Arts: Music, dance, drama, painting
- Clubs: Science club, literary club, eco club
- Leadership: Student council, house system

# Values & Mission
> Our mission is to nurture young minds to become compassionate leaders, critical thinkers, and responsible citizens.
> Guided by our motto "Truth and Honesty", we provide quality education rooted in Catholic tradition.
> We focus on academic excellence, character development, and holistic growth.

# Achievements
- 70+ years of educational excellence (1954-2026)
- Consistent academic performance in GBSHSE examinations
- Strong alumni network across professions
- Active community service and social responsibility programs

# Important Dates
- Academic Year: June to April
- Admissions Period: December to March
- Board Exams: February-March (Class X)
- School Holidays: Summer (May-June), Winter (December), Festival breaks
